sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: After 13 consecutive days of airstrikes, the United States and Iran have temporarily paused their fighting.
sentences.zh: 经过连续13天的空袭，美国和伊朗暂时停火了。

sentences.en: But the conflict could resume at any moment.
sentences.zh: 但冲突可能随时会重新爆发。

sentences.en: And inside Iran, a small but powerful faction is determined to make sure that it does.
sentences.zh: 而在伊朗国内，一个小而强大的派系正决心确保这种情况发生。

sentences.en: Today, Abdi Latif Tahir and Farnaz Fasihi explain the profound divisions within Iran about whether to keep fighting or to try to make peace.
sentences.zh: 今天，阿卜迪·拉蒂夫·塔希尔和法尔纳斯·法西希将解释伊朗内部关于是继续战斗还是尝试谋求和平的深刻分歧。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月28日，星期二。

sentences.en: This was a very choreographed event from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，这就是一场精心编排的活动。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, the Iranian government allowed my colleague, Abdi Latif Tahir, into the country.
sentences.zh: 几周前，伊朗政府允许我的同事阿卜迪·拉蒂夫·塔希尔进入该国。

sentences.en: Immediately, we landed in Tahrani.
sentences.zh: 我们一落地就在德黑兰。

sentences.en: We got through immigration.
sentences.zh: 我们通过了海关。

sentences.en: And essentially, you're met there by your minder.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你在那里就会遇到你的随行人员。

sentences.en: It was not long after the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就在不久前，美国

sentences.en: and Iran had signed a tentative peace deal.
sentences.zh: 和伊朗签署了一项临时的和平协议。

sentences.en: And Abdi became the first Times reporter to get into Iran in months.
sentences.zh: 阿卜迪成了几个月来第一位进入伊朗的《时报》记者。

sentences.en: We had two government-appointed translators and a guide who pretty much went everywhere with us.
sentences.zh: 我们有两位政府指派的翻译和一个几乎去哪都跟着我们的导游。

sentences.en: We could not leave the hotel, essentially, without planning with them where we wanted to go, what we wanted to see.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们无法离开酒店，除非和他们计划好我们要去哪里、想看什么。

sentences.en: And he was there for a very specific purpose, to observe the multi-day funeral service for Iran's former Ayatollah, Ali Khomeini, who had been killed by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他去那里的目的非常明确，就是去观察伊朗前最高领袖阿里·哈梅内伊的多日葬礼。哈梅内伊在伊朗战争初期被美国

sentences.en: and Israel in the early days of the Iran war.
sentences.zh: 和以色列杀害。

sentences.en: And Abdi says his every movement at the funeral services was heavily monitored.
sentences.zh: 阿卜迪表示，他在葬礼上的每一个举动都受到严密监控。

sentences.en: They listened in on pretty much all the interviews.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎监听了所有的采访。

sentences.en: And one of the minders was also very open with us.
sentences.zh: 而且其中一个随行人员对我们也相当坦诚。

sentences.en: And essentially, he told me that, yes, at the end of every day, he basically was expected to, like, send a report about our activities, where we went, what we did during that day.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他告诉我，是的，在每天结束时，他基本上都要发一份报告，汇报我们的活动、我们去了哪里、那天做了什么。

sentences.en: Abdi, why do you think that Iran let you into the country?
sentences.zh: 阿卜迪，你认为伊朗为什么让你进入这个国家？

sentences.en: What do you think that they wanted you to see?
sentences.zh: 你认为他们想让你看到什么？

sentences.en: I think they definitely wanted us to see the way people had come out to mourn Ali Khamenei, the supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们绝对想让我们看到人们出来悼念最高领袖阿里·哈梅内伊的方式。

sentences.en: So we were very much in the middle of the capital, the center of Tehran.
sentences.zh: 所以我们身处首都的正中央，德黑兰的中心。

sentences.en: And for days on end, you couldn't escape the soundscape that was coming from outside, the chanting, the mourning, the wailing.
sentences.zh: 连续好几天，你都无法摆脱从外面传来的声音，诵经声、哀悼声、哭嚎声。

sentences.en: You kind of felt that you had been signed up for this very much stage-managed, choreographed scene.
sentences.zh: 你多少会觉得你已经加入了一个高度排练、精心编排的场景。

sentences.en: So you had the first day where the dignitaries from all across the world came to pay their respects.
sentences.zh: 所以第一天，来自世界各地的政要前来表达敬意。

sentences.en: And then there was a procession held at the Zadi Square in which the body of Khamenei and his relatives were now being viewed by the public.
sentences.zh: 然后在扎迪广场举行了一场游行，哈梅内伊和他的亲属的遗体现在正供公众瞻仰。

sentences.en: And there were millions who showed up that day throughout the day and essentially, like, you know, came to see the bodies despite the heat, despite the haze,
sentences.zh: 那天一整天都有数百万人出现，基本上，你知道的，不顾炎热、不顾雾霾，来看遗体，

sentences.en: despite everything else.
sentences.zh: 不顾一切阻碍。

sentences.en: People came from all over the country.
sentences.zh: 人们从全国各地赶来。

sentences.en: They were young, they were old, they were on wheelchairs, they were on crutches.
sentences.zh: 他们有年轻的，有年老的，有坐轮椅的，有拄拐杖的。

sentences.en: The journalists were definitely being allowed to, like, go on bridges and on top of the buildings so that we could see the sea of people who are coming through.
sentences.zh: 记者们绝对被允许走到桥上和建筑物顶部，以便我们能看到如潮水般涌来的人群。

sentences.en: So you definitely got a sense that even the access to these buildings were choreographed in such a way that it was like you had to see,
sentences.zh: 所以你确实有一种感觉，甚至对这些建筑物的出入也是经过精心编排的，就像你必须看到、

sentences.en: you had to experience how everybody has come from all over the country to mourn their leader.
sentences.zh: 你必须体验每个人是如何从全国各地赶来哀悼他们的领袖的。

sentences.en: And is grief the prevailing feeling that you get from this crowd?
sentences.zh: 悲伤是你在这些人群中感受到的主要情绪吗？

sentences.en: What exactly are you hearing from them?
sentences.zh: 你究竟从他们那里听到了什么？

sentences.en: You know, many people, you know, were in tears, they were very sad, but they, even when they were crying, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多人泪流满面，他们非常难过，但他们，即使在哭泣的时候，你知道，

sentences.en: their expressions would very quickly harden into anger and defiance.
sentences.zh: 他们的表情也会很快变得愤怒和反叛。

sentences.en: And I remember talking to this woman, her name was Farishteh Sultan Ali,
sentences.zh: 我记得我和这位女士交谈过，她叫法里什特·苏ultan·阿里，

sentences.en: and I watched her for a while before I approached her because she was carrying this flag that talked about revenge and, but she was like really in tears.
sentences.zh: 我在接近她之前观察了一会儿，因为她拿着一面谈到复仇的旗帜，但她真的泪流满面。

sentences.en: And at some point when she calmed down, like, you know, I approached her and very quickly this idea of negotiations came up and she was very opposed to that.
sentences.zh: 当她平静下来时，你知道，我接近了她，这个关于谈判的想法很快就被提出来了，她非常反对。

sentences.en: And I was like, well, it seems like the guns have silence now and essentially that has even allowed for this massive funeral to happen.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，看起来现在枪声已经沉寂了，基本上这甚至促成了这场盛大的葬礼。

sentences.en: And she said, yes, that's OK, but we do not want these talks.
sentences.zh: 她说，是的，那没关系，但我们不想要这些会谈。

sentences.en: We do not want these negotiations.
sentences.zh: 我们不想要这些谈判。

sentences.en: We want revenge for our slain leader and we want revenge for everyone else who was killed and all the institutions that were impacted.
sentences.zh: 我们要为我们遇害的领袖复仇，我们要为所有其他被杀害的人以及所有受影响的机构复仇。

sentences.en: And she said something that I will not forget.
sentences.zh: 她说了我不会忘记的一句话。

sentences.en: She said, like, you know, Trump cannot scare us with death.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，特朗普不能用死亡来吓唬我们。

sentences.en: Trump cannot scare us with death.
sentences.zh: 特朗普不能用死亡来吓唬我们。

sentences.en: In other words, we're willing to die in order to seek this revenge.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，为了寻求这种复仇，我们愿意去死。

sentences.en: People did not want diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 人们不想要外交。

sentences.en: They did not want the talks.
sentences.zh: 他们不想要会谈。

sentences.en: They were not for compromising.
sentences.zh: 他们不打算妥协。

sentences.en: There was definitely a lot of calls for the killing of Trump.
sentences.zh: 现场肯定有很多呼吁杀死特朗普的声音。

sentences.en: There was definitely a lot of death to America, death to Israel.
sentences.zh: 肯定有很多打倒美国、打倒以色列的口号。

sentences.en: And I think if there's one word that really defined these public mourning ceremonies, it's the word revenge, which is intiqam.
sentences.zh: 我想如果有一个词真正定义了这些公众悼念仪式，那就是“复仇”，也就是“intiqam”。

sentences.en: We saw that written in English, in Arabic, in Farsi.
sentences.zh: 我们看到它用英文、阿拉伯文、波斯文写着。

sentences.en: It was on banners.
sentences.zh: 它在横幅上。

sentences.en: It was on posters.
sentences.zh: 它在海报上。

sentences.en: It was on flags.
sentences.zh: 它在旗帜上。

sentences.en: Like, you know, people were wearing shirts that basically said that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们穿着基本上写着这个词的衬衫。

sentences.en: And pretty much like the dozens and dozens of people that I interviewed throughout my time in Iran at these massive ceremonies and processions,
sentences.zh: 在我逗留伊朗期间，在这些盛大的仪式和游行中，我采访了几十甚至上百人，

sentences.en: that is the message everybody wanted to leave with me, that we will not compromise and we want revenge for our slain leader.
sentences.zh: 这就是每个人都想留给我的信息：我们绝不妥协，我们要为遇害的领袖复仇。

sentences.en: The timing of what you're seeing here seems extremely important because these crowds demanding revenge, demanding that Trump be killed,
sentences.zh: 你在这里看到的时机似乎极其重要，因为这些要求复仇、要求杀死特朗普的人群，

sentences.en: they know full well that their government has just signed a peace agreement, this memorandum of understanding, with the United States and with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们非常清楚，他们的政府刚刚与美国和特朗普总统签署了一项和平协议，即这项谅解备忘录。

sentences.en: And what they're calling for is the exact opposite of that.
sentences.zh: 而他们所呼吁的恰恰相反。

sentences.en: So, how do they square that?
sentences.zh: 那么，他们是如何调和这一点的呢？

sentences.en: So, during these public mourning ceremonies,
sentences.zh: 所以在这些公开的哀悼仪式期间，

sentences.en: the public very much showed how they felt about some of these political leaders who had gone and had taken part in the negotiations with the United States.
sentences.zh: 公众充分表达了他们对其中一些去参加与美国谈判的政治领导人的看法。

sentences.en: So, you had, for instance,
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，

sentences.en: Iran's president and Iran's foreign minister then showing up to these events and they were confronted and targeted by crowds who basically were very angry at the fact that they had taken part in these diplomatic talks.
sentences.zh: 伊朗总统和伊朗外长随后出现在这些活动中，他们遭到人群的质问和针对，人群对他们参与这些外交会谈感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: Peace out!
sentences.zh: 滚开！

sentences.en: Peace out!
sentences.zh: 滚开！

sentences.en: Peace out!
sentences.zh: 滚开！

sentences.en: Peace out!
sentences.zh: 滚开！

sentences.en: President Pazish Kian, you know, was nearly knocked to the ground by these crowds who were shouting death to the compromiser,
sentences.zh: 佩泽什基安总统，你知道的，差点被这些高喊“打倒妥协者”、

sentences.en: death to the appeaser and his security forces essentially rushed to evacuate him.
sentences.zh: “打倒绥靖者”的人群撞倒，他的安全部队仓促赶来将他撤离。

sentences.en: You had a foreign minister, Araqqi, who, you know, some of the people in the crowd started throwing stones at him.
sentences.zh: 还有外长阿拉格齐，你知道的，人群中的一些人开始向他扔石头。

sentences.en: They were very hostile.
sentences.zh: 他们极具敌意。

sentences.en: They were chanting, you know, basically calling him a traitor.
sentences.zh: 他们高喊口号，基本上骂他是叛徒。

sentences.en: And essentially, he also had to flee the scene where he was.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他也不得不逃离他当时所在的现场。

sentences.en: And it was so indicative of the ways in which revenge and avenging the supreme leader had become so central to how people, at least the people who showed up for these ceremonies,
sentences.zh: 这充分说明了复仇和为最高领袖复仇已经变得多么核心，对于人们，至少是对于出现在这些仪式上的人来说，

sentences.en: how they felt about that.
sentences.zh: 他们对此有着怎样的感受。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because in this highly choreographed scene that the government is putting on and wants you to see, the mourners are actually turning on the government's leaders.
sentences.zh: 因为在这个政府精心编排、希望你看到的场景中，哀悼者实际上正在调转枪头对准政府领导人。

sentences.en: That's how deep these divisions are.
sentences.zh: 这些分歧就是这么深。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you have, like, all these hardliners, right, who are very much opposed to these negotiations and diplomacy with the United States.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，所有这些强硬派，他们非常反对与美国的这些谈判和外交。

sentences.en: And the only thing that they talk about and they think about and they repeat consistently is that we want intiqam, intiqam, revenge, revenge.
sentences.zh: 他们唯一谈论、思考并不断重复的事情就是，我们想要“intiqam”、intiqam、复仇、复仇。

sentences.en: It was amid these intense calls for revenge, as the Ayatollah's funeral drew to a close, that the divisions Abdi saw on the streets played out on an even bigger scale.
sentences.zh: 正是在这些强烈的复仇呼声中，随着阿亚图拉葬礼的接近尾声，阿卜迪在街头看到的分歧在更大的规模上演了。

sentences.en: In a surprise move, Iran struck three ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.zh: 在一次突如其来的行动中，伊朗袭击了霍尔木兹海峡的三艘船只。

sentences.en: A U.S.
sentences.zh: 一名美国

sentences.en: official telling me that this was a gross violation of the memorandum of understanding by Iran.
sentences.zh: 官员告诉我，这是伊朗对谅解备忘录的严重违反。

sentences.en: And that delicate peace agreement with the United States began to crumble.
sentences.zh: 与美国那份脆弱的和平协议开始瓦解。

sentences.en: After the break, my colleague, Farnas Fasehi, on the war, playing out inside of Iran's government.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我的同事法尔纳斯·法西希将带来关于在伊朗政府内部展开的战争的报道。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是刘文娜。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天都创作“拼写蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“方框字母”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 加上斜杠 games，今天就开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: Farnas, Abdi just described this profound divide that was on display during the Ayatollah's funeral
sentences.zh: 法尔纳斯，阿卜迪刚刚描述了在阿亚图拉葬礼上表现出的深刻分歧，

sentences.en: between hardline religious supporters of the regime and the government officials who negotiated a peace deal with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 即政权的强硬宗教支持者与同美国谈判和平协议的政府官员之间的分歧。

sentences.en: And when Iran attacked U.S.
sentences.zh: 当伊朗袭击美国

sentences.en: ships, the first question, I think quite logically, was who was responsible for that decision?
sentences.zh: 军舰时，我认为很顺理成章的第一个问题是，谁应对这一决定负责？

sentences.en: And had these hardliners persuaded the government to restart this war?
sentences.zh: 这些强硬派是否说服了政府重启这场战争？

sentences.en: Well, that's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是个很好的问题。

sentences.en: I think we haven't reached a definitive answer on exactly who made the decision or how what has been seen as a provocative act to attack these ships really came about.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还没有得出确切的答案，究竟是谁做出了这个决定，或者袭击这些船只这样一个被视为挑衅的行为是如何真正发生的。

sentences.en: Right after this, the United States said in briefings to our colleagues that the Iranian mediators that they'd been in touch with told the United States that it wasn't us,
sentences.zh: 在此之后不久，美国在向我们同事的简报中表示，他们一直在联系的伊朗调解人告诉美国，这不是我们干的，

sentences.en: that these were like rogue hardline elements within the Revolutionary Guards that had decided to attack the ships.
sentences.zh: 这些是革命卫队内部的流氓强硬派分子，他们决定袭击这些船只。

sentences.en: I think this was one of the very few and only attacks that they didn't officially claim and issue a statement saying we did this.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是为数不多的几次他们没有公开认领并发表声明说“这是我们干的”的袭击之一。

sentences.en: When I reached out to sources, I heard the same thing from a source that the attack on the ship came as a surprise to the president, to the foreign minister.
sentences.zh: 当我联系消息人士时，我从一个消息源那里听到了同样的说法，即对船只的袭击对总统和外长来说是一个意外。

sentences.en: And it was sort of seen as hardliners who have been advocating to drag Iran back to the war and derail the talks, you know, taking this kind of an action.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上被视为一直主张将伊朗拖回战争并破坏谈判的强硬派采取的一种行动。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: I just want to say that that's quite an extraordinary prospect that hardliners were so intent on ending this peace process and undermining the memorandum of understanding that had been reached by the official Iranian government that they would launch an attack against the United States to do that.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，这是一个相当非同寻常的前景：强硬派如此坚决地想要结束这一和平进程，破坏伊朗官方政府达成的谅解备忘录，以至于他们会发起对美国的袭击来达到这个目的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's extraordinary because if this is true, if the hardliners would, on their own, without central command,
sentences.zh: 这很不寻常，因为如果这是真的，如果强硬派在没有中央指挥的情况下，

sentences.en: decide to take such a consequential step with massive consequences for Iran, for the 90 million people there, for the region,
sentences.zh: 擅自决定采取这样一个对伊朗、对那里的9000万人民、对整个地区都有着巨大后果的重大步骤，

sentences.en: what does that say about sort of the disarray within the Iranian rank and file?
sentences.zh: 这说明了伊朗底层官兵内部的混乱状况到了什么地步？

sentences.en: Like, who made that decision?
sentences.zh: 到底是谁做出了那个决定？

sentences.en: This speaks to the massive divide in the system.
sentences.zh: 这说明了体制内部巨大的分歧。

sentences.en: At this very pivotal, critical time in the country's political history, it seems like Iran's government and leadership is at war with itself.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家政治历史上这个非常关键、至关重要的时刻，伊朗的政府和领导层似乎在进行内战。

sentences.en: Well, Farnas, that's really what we want to talk to you about as such an expert on the internal workings of Iran, this emerging war inside Iran over the war itself,
sentences.zh: 嗯，法尔纳斯，这正是我们想跟你谈的，作为伊朗内部运作的专家，这场在伊朗内部围绕战争本身展开的新兴战争，

sentences.en: and who is winning at the moment and what it means for the future of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 目前谁在获胜，它对冲突的未来意味着什么。

sentences.en: So help us understand the various factions that are currently at war with each other.
sentences.zh: 所以请帮我们理解目前互相交战的各派势力。

sentences.en: Well, I'll start by saying that political differences and infighting within Iran's political circles is not new.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我首先要说的是，伊朗政治圈内部的分歧和内斗并不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: They've always sort of existed in Iran's modern politics, the Islamic Republic's rule.
sentences.zh: 它们在伊朗的现代政治中、在伊斯兰共和国的统治下一直都某种程度上存在。

sentences.en: But what's really new here is that it's happening within the conservative camp, right?
sentences.zh: 但这里真正新鲜的是，它正在保守派阵营内部发生，对吧？

sentences.en: You've traditionally had the conservatives that sort of believe in a more ideological view of governing and the reformers who wanted to keep the Islamic Republic rule,
sentences.zh: 传统上，保守派倾向于更偏向意识形态的治理观，而改革派则希望保持伊斯兰共和国的统治，

sentences.en: but reform and change.
sentences.zh: 但寻求改革与改变。

sentences.en: But that's not what's happening now.
sentences.zh: 但现在情况已经变了。

sentences.en: Within the conservative group that runs the country right now, that holds power, which includes the powerful Revolutionary Guards Generals, there's major differences and fractures.
sentences.zh: 在目前统治国家、掌握权力的保守派内部，其中包括强大的革命卫队将军们，存在着重大的分歧和裂痕。

sentences.en: Okay, well, help us understand the divisions within this conservative world of Iran's leadership.
sentences.zh: 好吧，请给我们讲讲伊朗领导层中这个保守派内部的分裂。

sentences.en: So on one side, you have the ultra-hardliners, led by a politician named Saeed Jalili.
sentences.zh: 所以在一方，是以一位名叫赛义德·贾利利（Saeed Jalili）的政客为首的超级强硬派。

sentences.en: They have a worldview that says Iran must never engage with the United States, Israel must be destroyed,
sentences.zh: 他们的世界观是：伊朗绝不能与美国接触，以色列必须被消灭，

sentences.en: that this ideological Islamist extremist view that was sort of the beginning of this revolution is very much how they plan to rule.
sentences.zh: 这种作为这场革命初期的那种意识形态伊斯兰极端主义观点，在很大程度上就是他们计划的统治方式。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Don't talk to the United States.
sentences.zh: 不要与美国对话。

sentences.en: Continue fighting.
sentences.zh: 继续战斗。

sentences.en: And this faction is a minority but still has constituents.
sentences.zh: 这一派虽然是少数，但依然有其选民基础。

sentences.en: They're the people that come out every time the government wants to rally its supporters onto the streets.
sentences.zh: 每当政府想要动员支持者走上街头时，出来的人就是他们。

sentences.en: And at the funeral of the late senior Ayatollah Khomeini, these are the people who were busts from all over the country, came out in millions, were, you know,
sentences.zh: 在已故资深大阿亚图拉霍梅尼的葬礼上，这些人是从全国各地用大巴车拉来的，成百上千地走出来，你知道的，

sentences.en: waving red flags of revenge.
sentences.zh: 挥舞着红色的复仇旗帜。

sentences.en: So this is the core constituent of the system.
sentences.zh: 所以这是这个体制的核心选民基础。

sentences.en: And thus, they can't really be ignored and set aside, right?
sentences.zh: 因此，他们真的无法被忽视和抛在一边，对吧？

sentences.en: Because they're always there no matter what.
sentences.zh: 因为无论如何他们总是在那里。

sentences.en: They always show up for the regime, right?
sentences.zh: 他们总是为政权挺身而出，对吧？

sentences.en: So this is the religious base and foundation for this theocracy.
sentences.zh: 所以这是这个神权政体的宗教根基和基础。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，完全如此。

sentences.en: They're the foundation for the theocracy.
sentences.zh: 他们是神权政体的基础。

sentences.en: If I were to say what their numbers are in Iran's 90 million, I would say somewhere between 10 to 20 percent,
sentences.zh: 如果要在伊朗9千万人口中评估他们的数量，我想大概占百分之十到二十之间，

sentences.en: judging from the numbers of the polls where they always show up and the candidates that they pick.
sentences.zh: 从他们总是现身的民调数据以及他们挑选的候选人来看。

sentences.en: So they are a minority, but they're a very vocal and loyal minority.
sentences.zh: 所以他们是少数，但却是一个声音响亮且忠诚的少数。

sentences.en: And who's on the other side of this divide?
sentences.zh: 那分裂的另一方是谁呢？

sentences.en: So on the other side of the divide is really the senior leadership of the government and many powerful generals of the Revolutionary Guards.
sentences.zh: 分裂的另一方实际上是政府的高层领导以及革命卫队的许多强力将军。

sentences.en: This coalition represents the pragmatics within the system.
sentences.zh: 这个联盟代表了体制内的务实派。

sentences.en: General Muammar Bagheir-Ghalibov, the Speaker of Parliament and the person leading negotiations with the United States,
sentences.zh: 议长、负责与美国谈判的穆罕默德·巴吉尔-卡利巴夫（Muammar Bagheir-Ghalibov）将军，
zh_words: 穆罕默德·巴吉尔-卡利巴夫

sentences.en: has done repeated interviews on state television and has said in statements that,
sentences.zh: 在国家电视台接受了多次采访，并在声明中表示，

sentences.en: look, we have to take whatever leverage we've gained in the war and turn it into diplomacy, that diplomacy is not a sign of defeat or surrender,
sentences.zh: 听着，我们必须把我们在战争中获得的任何筹码转化为外交，外交不是失败或投降的标志，

sentences.en: but we can actually make some gains by negotiating with the United States.
sentences.zh: 相反，通过与美国谈判，我们实际上可以取得一些成果。

sentences.en: We can't fight endlessly.
sentences.zh: 我们不能无休止地战斗下去。

sentences.en: We have to open up Iran economically.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在经济上对伊朗进行开放。

sentences.en: We have to get rid of the sanctions.
sentences.zh: 我们必须摆脱制裁。

sentences.en: So this group is of the view that these hardline policies of let's fight until our last breath,
sentences.zh: 所以这一派的观点是，这种“战斗到最后一口气”的强硬政策，

sentences.en: let's drag the country into chaos and instability is not really the direction they want to take the country.
sentences.zh: 把国家拖入混乱和动荡，并不是他们真正想带国家走的方向。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So these would seem to be the peace seekers, the people who struck a deal with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以这些似乎是寻求和平的人，是那些与美国达成协议的人，

sentences.en: because they want to preserve what's left of their country and rebuild it rather than fight endlessly at the risk of having nothing left in Iran at the end of this conflict.
sentences.zh: 因为他们想要保全国家剩下的部分并进行重建，而不是无休止地战斗，冒着在这场冲突结束后伊朗一无所有的风险。

sentences.en: Does this group include Iran's current supreme leader, the son of the late Ayatollah who was killed by Israel and the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 这个群体包括伊朗现任最高领袖、也就是被以色列和美国杀害的已故阿亚图拉的儿子吗？

sentences.en: That would seem to be a key question.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一个关键问题。

sentences.en: It's a key question because both sides are trying to claim Moshtab al-Khamenei, the new supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关键问题，因为双方都在试图争取新最高领袖莫杰塔巴·哈梅内伊（Moshtab al-Khamenei）的支持。

sentences.en: He's been absent from view because he's in hiding, fearing assassination.
sentences.zh: 他一直没有露面，因为他为了躲避暗杀而藏匿起来了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We've talked about this.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过这个。

sentences.en: And nobody has heard his voice because sources say that his face was burned in the airstrikes on their compound and his vocal cords were damaged.
sentences.zh: 没有人听到他的声音，因为消息人士称，他的脸在针对他们大院的空袭中被烧伤，声带也受损了。

sentences.en: And I think this absence of Moshtab al-Khamenei has created a real void.
sentences.zh: 我认为莫杰塔巴·哈梅内伊的缺席造成了一个真正的真空。

sentences.en: And in that void where the father used to have a yes or no vote, he had authority to have sort of a final say over matters.
sentences.zh: 在这个原本由父亲拥有一票否决权、对各种事务拥有最终决定权的真空地带，

sentences.en: The son doesn't have that authority.
sentences.zh: 儿子却没有那种权威。

sentences.en: He doesn't have that religious clout.
sentences.zh: 他没有那种宗教影响力。

sentences.en: He doesn't have that political clout.
sentences.zh: 他也没有那种政治影响力。

sentences.en: So this has created a kind of space where these divisions can fester.
sentences.zh: 所以这创造了一种空间，让这些分歧得以恶化。

sentences.en: You're saying without a supreme leader who can shut down these kinds of divisions or paper over them and call the shots, then even though, for example,
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，如果没有一个能够平息这些分歧、掩盖矛盾并一锤定音的最高领袖，那么即使例如，

sentences.en: the hardliners are a minority, they can exert a fair amount of influence.
sentences.zh: 强硬派只是少数，他们也能施加相当大的影响力。

sentences.en: They can perhaps, I know we're not sure, even maybe restart the war because there isn't a strong enough person to ensure that there's real unity in the leadership.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至可能——我知道我们不敢确定——由于没有一个足够强有力的人来确保领导层真正的团结，而重新挑起战争。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，完全如此。

sentences.en: There's no unity in the leadership.
sentences.zh: 领导层根本不团结。

sentences.en: You know, I think that Moshtaba has, to the extent that he's issued written statements, has said, put your differences aside,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我认为莫杰塔巴在其发出的书面声明中，曾表示过把分歧放在一边，

sentences.en: that these divisions are being closely watched by Iran's enemies and it suggests that we're weak.
sentences.zh: 这些分歧正受到伊朗敌人的密切关注，这表明我们很软弱。

sentences.en: But nobody's really listening to him.
sentences.zh: 但根本没人听他的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the remarkable thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这才是最惊人的地方。

sentences.en: Like, you have, like, the hardliner supporters in rallies shout,
sentences.zh: 就像，你在集会上看到强硬派支持者高喊，

sentences.en: the only way we will believe that Moshtaba supports this deal or supports the policies is if we hear from him directly or we see him.
sentences.zh: 我们相信莫杰塔巴支持这个协议或支持这些政策的唯一方法，就是我们直接听到他的声音或者见到他。

sentences.en: And lawmakers that are aligned with the hardliners have even publicly accused the government of staging a coup to bypass the supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 与强硬派结盟的议员甚至公开指责政府策划了一场政变以架空最高领袖。

sentences.en: So the hardliners, if I'm hearing this correctly, are suggesting that the pragmatists making peace with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我没听错的话，强硬派是在暗示，与美国媾和的务实派

sentences.en: may be doing that without the authorization of the supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 可能是在没有得到最高领袖授权的情况下这样做的。

sentences.en: They're questioning the legitimacy of the peace process.
sentences.zh: 他们在质疑和平进程的合法性。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And in its own defense, the pragmatists have all come out and said, look, everything we're doing is with Moshtaba's approval.
sentences.zh: 为了自辩，务实派纷纷站出来表示，听着，我们所做的一切都是得到了莫杰塔巴批准的。

sentences.en: We would not make any critical decisions, including negotiations or concessions to the United States, without the supreme leader's involvement.
sentences.zh: 在没有最高领袖参与的情况下，我们不会做出任何重大决定，包括与美国的谈判或妥协。

sentences.en: And we have his backing.
sentences.zh: 我们有他的支持。

sentences.en: So this is, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以这就是，你知道的，

sentences.en: both sides trying to claim support of Moshtaba and Moshtaba being on their team without him really coming out clearly and saying which side he's clearly endorsing.
sentences.zh: 双方都试图宣称获得莫杰塔巴的支持，而莫杰塔巴则没有明确站出来说他到底支持哪一方，从而让人觉得他在他们这一边。

sentences.en: So far, Farnas, you're really describing a conflict within Iran's government, this small group of hardliners who are undoing the work of a much larger group of pragmatists.
sentences.zh: 法尔纳斯，到目前为止，你真切地描述了伊朗政府内部的冲突，这一小撮强硬派正在破坏远为庞大的务实派群体的工作。

sentences.en: Based on previous conversations you and I have had on this show, I feel safe in assuming that the majority of Iranians,
sentences.zh: 根据你我此前在这个节目中的对话，我觉得可以安全地假设，大多数伊朗人——

sentences.en: you've often put it at 70 to 80 percent of the country's population,
sentences.zh: 你经常将其描述为占国家人口的百分之七十到八十，

sentences.en: that just want peace and just want to go about their lives and are not so attached to any one vision of an ideology in Iran,
sentences.zh: 他们只想要和平，只想要过日子，并不那么执着于伊朗的某一种意识形态愿景，

sentences.en: that they don't like the fact that this peace has been disrupted by the hardliners.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢这种和平被强硬派破坏的事实。

sentences.en: So what are they saying and do they have any influence over any of this?
sentences.zh: 那么他们在说些什么？他们对这一切有任何影响力吗？

sentences.en: I think that there is a very large, silent majority of Iranians who don't want the war, but also don't necessarily like the Islamic Republic regime or support it.
sentences.zh: 我认为伊朗存在一个非常庞大、沉默的多数群体，他们不希望发生战争，但也不一定喜欢伊斯兰共和国政权或支持它。

sentences.en: They feel like their lives and livelihoods are being upended by these radical decisions that the hardliners are making with very direct consequences on their lives,
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己的生活和生计正被强硬派做出的这些极端决定所颠覆，这些决定对他们的生活、

sentences.en: on their safety, on their future.
sentences.zh: 安全和未来有着非常直接的后果。

sentences.en: And they are very angry at the hardliners and they are saying that we didn't want the war, we don't want our infrastructure to be ruined, we don't, you know,
sentences.zh: 他们对强硬派感到非常愤怒，他们说我们不想要战争，我们不希望我们的基础设施被毁，我们不希望，你知道的，

sentences.en: the economy is at a near collapse.
sentences.zh: 经济濒临崩溃。

sentences.en: There's 400 percent inflation on basic groceries.
sentences.zh: 基本食品的通货膨胀率达到了百分之四百。

sentences.en: So Iranians are under tremendous amount of pressure and uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 因此，伊朗人正承受着巨大的压力和不确定性。

sentences.en: And we hear this all the time that the majority of Iranians feel like they are caught in the crossfires of the United States, Israel and the regime and they're being squeezed.
sentences.zh: 我们经常听到这种说法，大多数伊朗人觉得自己夹在美国、以色列和政权的交火之中，备受挤压。

sentences.en: And nobody's really thinking about their well-being and what they really want.
sentences.zh: 没有人真正关心他们的福祉以及他们真正想要什么。

sentences.en: There was this online petition that was going on that really captured this sense where Iranians were digitally signing on to this petition saying let's send all the hardliners,
sentences.zh: 曾有一个网络请愿活动，恰恰捕捉到了这种情绪，伊朗人纷纷在请愿书上数字签名，要求把所有的强硬派——

sentences.en: the lawmakers and the politicians who are calling for constant war to the south of Iran where they would be under nightly bombardments.
sentences.zh: 那些呼吁不断战争的议员和政客——送到伊朗南部，让他们饱受夜间轰炸之苦。

sentences.en: And they would see the consequences of what they're advocating for because they're sitting in the safety of their bunkers and they're advocating for war against the country,
sentences.zh: 让他们看看他们所主张的事情会带来什么后果，因为他们坐在安全的掩体里，却在主张针对这个国家、

sentences.en: its infrastructure and its people.
sentences.zh: 其基础设施及其人民的战争。

sentences.en: Well, Farnaz, let's say that the Supreme Leader were to decide in the coming days or weeks that he's fed up with this infighting,
sentences.zh: 那么，法尔纳斯，假设最高领袖在未来几天或几周内决定，他受够了这种内讧，

sentences.en: that he recognizes that a minority within a minority, the hardliners within the conservative leadership, are dragging the country back into war and he's tired of it.
sentences.zh: 他认识到保守派领导层内部的少数中的少数——强硬派正在把国家重新拖入战争，他对此感到厌倦。

sentences.en: And he were to make a public appearance, use his own voice, let's say that's suddenly possible,
sentences.zh: 假设他公开露面，用他自己的声音说话，假设这突然成为了可能，

sentences.en: which could in theory satisfy these hardliners who really want to hear from him directly.
sentences.zh: 这在理论上可以满足那些非常渴望直接听到他声音的强硬派。

sentences.en: And he says, stop it, enter the peace process, honor the peace process, let's rebuild Iran, let's end this phase of this conflict.
sentences.zh: 他说，停下来，加入和平进程，尊重和平进程，让我们重建伊朗，让我们结束这场冲突的这个阶段。

sentences.en: Could he do that?
sentences.zh: 他能做到这一点吗？

sentences.en: Would that message carry enough weight to silence these hardliners?
sentences.zh: 这个信息能有足够的分量让这些强硬派闭嘴吗？

sentences.en: It's a very good question, but it's one that remains unclear, partly because Moshe Taba Khamenei was a man in the shadows,
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题，但目前仍不清楚，部分原因是莫杰塔巴·哈梅内伊一直是个幕后人物，

sentences.en: not a whole lot is known about him or his style of leadership.
sentences.zh: 人们对他或他的领导风格知之甚少。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's really hard to gauge exactly how he will rule when he surfaces and how much clout he will have.
sentences.zh: 所以很难准确评估他浮出水面后将如何统治，以及他会有多大的影响力。

sentences.en: It's also a very risky prospect for him, Michael, because to do that, he would essentially have to declare that he fully trusts the United States and President Trump.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，对迈克尔来说这也是一个非常冒险的前景，因为要做到这一点，他基本上必须宣布他完全信任美国和特朗普总统。

sentences.en: And that despite the many times that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 尽管在伊朗看来，美国多次

sentences.en: has, in Iran's view, negated its obligations, both under the first nuclear deal, exiting from that and then attacking Iran in the midst of negotiations several times,
sentences.zh: 背信弃义：在第一份伊核协议下退出协议，然后在谈判期间多次袭击伊朗，

sentences.en: that he's sort of saying that I put my full trust in this deal with the United States.
sentences.zh: 而他却要说，我完全信任与美国的这份协议。

sentences.en: That's a very difficult thing, I think, for Iran's supreme leader to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为，对伊朗最高领袖来说，这是一件非常困难的事情。

sentences.en: So I think more realistically, even when he emerges,
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得更现实的是，即使在他露面之后，

sentences.en: he's going to try to navigate everybody and try to appeal to all sides just to allow himself a little bit of leverage everywhere and enough distance to claim it if it works and disown it if it falls apart.
sentences.zh: 他也会试图在各方之间周旋，试图迎合所有各方，从而为自己在各处都留下一丁点筹码，并保持足够的距离——如果成功了就揽功，如果搞砸了就撇清关系。

sentences.en: So the reason the supreme leader is unlikely to ever take sides as firmly as I just outlined is because it would risk his legitimacy with the hardliners in a way that he cannot tolerate.
sentences.zh: 因此，最高领袖不太可能像我刚才概述的那样坚定地站队，原因在于这会以一种他无法容忍的方式危及他在强硬派中的合法性。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，完全如此。

sentences.en: I mean, you have to remember that the Islamic Republic was created on this idea of fighting America, fighting Israel, of anti-Western ideals.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你必须记住，伊斯兰共和国是建立在反美、反以色列、反西方理念的基础之上的。

sentences.en: And for the supreme leader to completely do away with that and for the hardliners to set aside that animosity and that hostility,
sentences.zh: 如果最高领袖彻底抛弃这一点，如果强硬派抛弃这种敌意和对抗，

sentences.en: it would basically be the end of the Islamic Republic as we've known it.
sentences.zh: 那基本上就等于我们所熟知的伊斯兰共和国的终结。

sentences.en: And if that's gone, then what is left of the Islamic Republic?
sentences.zh: 如果这个没了，那伊斯兰共和国还剩下什么？

sentences.en: It's going to be a new Iran, a new system.
sentences.zh: 那将是一个新的伊朗，一个新的体制。

sentences.en: And I think that's why they're fighting so hard because they know if the pragmatists win, if really a peace deal, lasting peace deal with the United States works,
sentences.zh: 我想这就是他们拼死抵抗的原因，因为他们知道，如果务实派获胜，如果与美国的和平协议、持久和平协议真正发挥作用，

sentences.en: that they're going to basically be even more marginalized.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上会被进一步边缘化。

sentences.en: And what's now become very clear is that when the United States and Israel started this war,
sentences.zh: 现在变得非常清楚的一点是，当美国和以色列挑起这场战争时，

sentences.en: they thought that taking out the Ayatollah would mean taking out this revolutionary fervor and toppling it.
sentences.zh: 他们以为干掉阿亚图拉就等于消除了这种革命狂热并推翻政权。

sentences.en: And instead, it's still very much alive and still too potent a force for even the Ayatollah's son and successor to confront.
sentences.zh: 然而相反，这种狂热依然充满活力，其力量依然过于强大，以至于连阿亚图拉的儿子和继承人也无法与之对抗。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, you've heard President Trump say repeatedly that the wars brought regime change in Iran.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你曾多次听到特朗普总统说，这场战争给伊朗带来了政权更迭。

sentences.en: But there's been no regime change.
sentences.zh: 但并没有发生政权更迭。

sentences.en: And in fact, what we're seeing is that the country has become more militarized, that the hardliners are becoming more entrenched,
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们看到的是国家变得更加军国主义化，强硬派变得更加根深蒂固，

sentences.en: and that Iran's now being led by a supreme leader that doesn't have the kind of absolute power and clout to guide things one way or the other.
sentences.zh: 而且伊朗现在由一位最高领袖领导，他并不具备那种绝对权力和影响力来引导局势走向某个方向。

sentences.en: Well, Farnaz, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，法尔纳斯，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，迈克尔。

sentences.en: In an interview with NBC News, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在接受美国全国广播公司（NBC News）采访时，美国驻联合国大使

sentences.en: ambassador to the United Nations, Mike Waltz,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·沃尔兹（Mike Waltz）

sentences.en: acknowledged that divisions inside Iran's government have made it increasingly difficult for the Trump administration to negotiate a peace deal.
sentences.zh: 承认，伊朗政府内部的分歧使得特朗普政府越来越难以谈判达成和平协议。

sentences.en: What we are constantly seeing is on the Iranian regime side, they are divided, there is internal fighting, some are seeking the guidance of the supreme leader,
sentences.zh: 我们不断看到的是，在伊朗政权这边，他们存在分裂，内部在进行内斗，一些人在寻求最高领袖的指引，

sentences.en: others want to move into a different direction.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则想走向不同的方向。

sentences.en: And that makes it hugely challenging from a diplomatic standpoint, but to get to some reasonable resolution here.
sentences.zh: 从外交角度来看，这带来了巨大的挑战，但我们要在这里达成某种合理的决议。

sentences.en: I would take the president very seriously if I was the Iranian.
sentences.zh: 如果我是伊朗人，我会非常认真地对待总统的话。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: In Spain and France, officials are warning that extreme heat in the coming days could intensify what they're already calling the worst wildfire season in modern history.
sentences.zh: 在西班牙和法国，官员们发出警告称，未来几天极端高温可能会加剧他们已经称之为现代史上最糟糕的野火季。

sentences.en: In southwestern France, the wildfires have burned through nearly 300,000 acres and displaced at least 200,000 people.
sentences.zh: 在法国西南部，野火已经烧毁了近30万英亩的土地，并迫使至少20万人流离失所。

sentences.en: One of the largest peacetime evacuations in France's history.
sentences.zh: 这是法国历史上规模最大的和平时期疏散行动之一。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Spain.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在西班牙。

sentences.en: The country's prime minister said that the fires there have burned through hundreds of thousands of acres.
sentences.zh: 该国首相表示，那里的火灾已经烧毁了数十万英亩的土地。

sentences.en: And he said that the climate emergency that scientists have been warning about for years had arrived.
sentences.zh: 他还表示，科学家们多年来一直警告的气候紧急情况已经来临。

sentences.en: The new heat wave is expected to hit both Spain and France starting on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 预计新的热浪将于周三开始袭击西班牙和法国。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由杰克·德西多罗（Jack DeSidoro）、罗谢尔·班贾（Rochelle Banja）和香农·林恩（Shannon Lynn）制作。

sentences.zh: 其中包含马里恩·洛扎诺（Marion Lozano）和索菲亚·兰德曼（Sophia Landman）创作的音乐。

sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们将为节日期间的聚会做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线敏感而需要绝对黑暗才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝断片才能睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这非常具体。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程式或您喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
